en.title: Android games can resume across script hosts
en.body: Pass `services.storage` to `createSaveStore` to keep local checkpoints when switching between System WebView, standard V8 and trimmed V8. Games in the same app use separate asset roots to keep their saves independent. On a Galaxy Z Fold7, all three hosts restored progress after force-stop, migrated an older save once, and finished an admitted write before the game view reported closure.

zh.title: Android 游戏可跨脚本宿主续档
zh.body: 将 `services.storage` 传给 `createSaveStore`，即可在系统 WebView、标准 V8 和裁剪 V8 之间切换时保留本地进度。同一应用内的游戏可使用不同资源根目录隔离存档。在 Galaxy Z Fold7 上，三个宿主均能在强停后恢复进度，旧存档只迁移一次，已接纳的写入会在游戏视图关闭回调前完成。
